package.description: A retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp

en-US.description: A retro terminal music player inspired by Winamp
en-US.name: Cliamp
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- ci(release): pin Linux builds and cap the notes by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (a8386f8)
- docs(site): include WebM among the FFmpeg formats by Charlyls (@cartudev) (05dd52e)
- docs(site): list MP4 among the local audio formats by Charlyls (@cartudev) (3bb9cc1)
- style: gofmt the mp4 audio extension test by Charlyls (@cartudev) (2cc9734)
- feat(player): accept the audio stream of .mp4 files by Charlyls (@cartudev) (0fc1e7a)
- fix(ui): follow terminal colors in Ethereal by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (9928143)
- feat(navidrome): add track ratings by manuaudio (@manuaudio) (e30c677)
- feat(netease): add a cookies_file option by JazibAli360 (@JazibAli360) (8b1fe18)
- fix(resolve): play on.soundcloud.com short links by Renan Bezerra Guimarães (@RenanBezerraGuima) (5e36da0)
- test(lyrics): make the repeated timestamps test table-driven, add fraction and BOM cases by Jay Hemnani (@jayhemnani9910) (d708f65)
- docs(playlists): say relative paths in a local PLS file resolve from its folder by Jay Hemnani (@jayhemnani9910) (0424e29)
- fix(nix): refresh the vendor hash after the Telegram provider by Charlyls (@cartudev) (6f5a67e)
- fix(nix): refresh the vendor hash for the Go 1.27 toolchain by Charlyls (@cartudev) (1288b78)
- fix(nix): build with the Go 1.27 toolchain by Charlyls (@cartudev) (2385d92)
- docs(mediactl): correct the --player=cliamp note by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (ac76422)
- fix(ui): sanitize remote text before rendering (#685) by Acts1631 (@acts-1631) (f1296c9)
- feat(telegram): add a native MTProto Telegram provider (#651) by Carlos (@cartudev) (a65244f)
- feat(remote): add --params-file and --params-stdin to cliamp remote call (#641) by Renan Bezerra Guimarães (@RenanBezerraGuima) (fda4d4b)
- docs(plugins): list album_art_url in the event payloads (#654) by Carlos (@cartudev) (87d929e)
- feat(playlist): reverse the playlist order with Ctrl+O (#667) by Knut Åbjørsbråten (@Knutsi) (6a6fb24)
- fix(ui): align numbers in playlist search results (#674) by IgorM (@maliavko) (93c54bc)
- fix(plex): read the album year of a track (#676) by IgorM (@maliavko) (34e4cad)
- fix(tomlutil): match spaced and quoted headers by Ehab Kahwati (@Devehab) (c329220)
- fix(tomlutil): skip escaped quotes in """ strings by Ehab Kahwati (@Devehab) (1d22a1c)
- fix(tomlutil): tighten header detection by Ehab Kahwati (@Devehab) (3c72a8b)
- fix(tomlutil): handle header comments and [table] headers by Ehab Kahwati (@Devehab) (aed5bb9)
- fix(lyrics): show LRC lines at every time tag, in time order by Jay Hemnani (@jayhemnani9910) (f490f07)
- fix(radio): warn about unknown sections in radios.toml by Ehab Kahwati (@Devehab) (0baf1cd)
- fix(spotify): give album tracks the album's cover by BAK (@BAKocska) (84096f8)
- fix(resolve): resolve PLS paths against its folder by Jay Hemnani (@jayhemnani9910) (cb09863)
- fix(kittyimg): size the image before decoding it (#653) by Carlos (@cartudev) (02309c9)
- test(luaplugin): drop an unused layout fake field by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (d693e82)
- feat(ipc): add a start index to provider.load (#626) by Chad Thackray (@ChadThackray) (2a5e97b)
- fix(luaplugin): stop logging a Lua error as a timeout (#625) by Chad Thackray (@ChadThackray) (ebe3301)
- fix(player): trim MP3 encoder delay and padding (#623) by rxvt (@rxvt) (a33f600)
- fix: bump Go to 1.26.10 for govulncheck by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (9d61173)
- feat(bandcamp): stream your purchased collection (#521) by Lukasz Jagiello (@ljagiello) (195d8ae)
- refactor: add more constraints to lyrics and artist lookup by bl4zee (@bl4zee1g) (620e9fe)
- docs(plugins): document the image, layout, ui and vis APIs by Charlyls (@cartudev) (1b71802)
- fix(plugins): open image paths without blocking on a FIFO by Charlyls (@cartudev) (28746d9)
- fix(plugins): close the remaining review findings by Charlyls (@cartudev) (270ebd6)
- fix(plugins): address the review by Charlyls (@cartudev) (0136634)
- feat(plugins): render image panes as text blocks by Charlyls (@cartudev) (1f88895)
- feat(plugins): let plugins build panes, images and selectors by Charlyls (@cartudev) (3aad360)
- fix(plugins): validate and normalize allowed private address ports by Lukasz Chojnacki (@lchojnack) (e2a1b8c)
- feat(plugins): allow exact private addresses for self-hosted servers by Lukasz Chojnacki (@lchojnack) (f11b49e)
- fix: soundcloud: properly report artist by bl4zee (@bl4zee1g) (c087629)
- test(resolve): build a valid file URI for Windows paths by Jay Hemnani (@jayhemnani9910) (45b2f38)
- fix(resolve): accept the largest EXTINF duration by Jay Hemnani (@jayhemnani9910) (96d3be9)
- fix(resolve): play file:// entries in playlists by Jay Hemnani (@jayhemnani9910) (f0bd99d)
- fix(resolve): read EXTINF titles after attributes by Jay Hemnani (@jayhemnani9910) (83ade3e)
- feat(ui): add the Ethereal visualizer by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (5656a55)
- fix(review): hide EQ shortcut in minimal layout by SomSamantray (@SomSamantray) (9247dcc)
- docs(eq): document previous preset shortcut by SomSamantray (@SomSamantray) (1cd10a0)
- feat(eq): add previous preset shortcut by SomSamantray (@SomSamantray) (8651319)
- docs: name Windows source build toolchain by SomSamantray (@SomSamantray) (8f4f98f)
- docs: clarify Windows source build requirements by SomSamantray (@SomSamantray) (8408f49)
- fix: bump Go and x/net for govulncheck by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (ce8c65f)
- fix: skip a dead YouTube track and honor track limits by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (091a143)
- fix(ui): open local files off the UI thread by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (645346c)
- docs: match Windows config directory by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (c04406c)
- fix:respect hidden help bar in full screen visualizer by Raushan Kumar (@raushankumar72) (5d47a75)
- docs(site): describe hidden-file scans by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (48c56a3)
- feat(provider): find songs related to a Spotify or YouTube track (#581) by Gjermund Garaba (@gjermundgaraba) (0e3afcf)
- docs(site): note GNOME Keyring cookie dependency by jacobius (@jakovius) (6237b70)
- docs(ytmusic): include Debian and Ubuntu secretstorage package by jacobius (@jakovius) (bd1face)
- fix(setup): retain Chromium cookie-source example by jacobius (@jakovius) (6f16c6e)
- fix(resolve): skip dotfiles when scanning folders by Daniel Bae (@MrBeldum) (7c05974)
- fix(ui): report favorite toggles in the status line by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (080d0a8)
- fix(ui): stop status messages from shifting the frame by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (d11bce4)
- feat(radio): show live listener counts on cliamp radio rows by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (646b573)
- chore: exclude website, docs and generated files from language stats by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (f4f0882)
- fix(ui): Space advances only when marking tracks by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (0760dbd)
- fix(ui): use a check for marked tracks instead of a star by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (f2a3318)
- fix(ui): q closes the info, lyrics and device overlays by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (ea4e6f1)
- fix(ui): q closes the playlist manager and queue overlays by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (56e7ed8)
- docs: require a description body on every commit by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (2638110)
- fix(ui): name key targets in help and drop dead n hints by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (ed39a3c)
- fix(ui): keep overlays open when switching to an unconfigured provider by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (5675ddd)
- fix(ui): reject non-terminal stdout by Neo Lehmann (@legacynode) (2084402)
- fix(ui): hint valid keys on stray presses in confirm prompts by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (d2c4d6e)
- fix(ui): confirm before clearing the queue by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (792ad4e)
- fix(ui): advertise q as a close key for overlays by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (cdd2679)
- fix(ui): q exits the full-screen visualizer instead of quitting by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (dc4d489)
- fix(ui): open playlist manager with p from any provider pane by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (0714c18)
- feat(ui): show hidden shortcuts, hint unconfigured providers, clarify errors by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (575610f)
- fix(ui): let Esc leave the provider browser with an empty playlist by david s (@davidszp) (59d0ce4)
- fix(spotify): rebuild the session when the access point closes by BAK (@BAKocska) (355fc30)
- feat(ui): add YinYang visualizer mode by Erik Johansson (@erikrjohansson) (3e61ebe)
- fix(radio): jump to cliamp radio immediately with loading indicator by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (d35e4e9)
- remove extra playlist page for simplicity. the new playlist page is the playlist manager by Taha Sadough (@tahadx) (e36a777)
- test: make the new tests pass on Windows by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (b1a8848)
- build(nix): update the Go vendor hash by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (d776878)
- docs: add mac-notify to community plugins by David E. Barrera (@dbarrerap) (026c1b5)
- fix(playlist): read the LIST INFO tags of WAV files by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (0f42e20)
- fix(view): wrap the too-small message to the terminal width by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (387b147)
- fix(model): give Lua track events the decoded duration by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (2d1ce69)
- fix(cli): keep zero position, volume and index in status --json by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (8150661)
- fix(ipc): name a socket path that is too long by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (b38d1be)
- fix(ipc): reject unknown shuffle, repeat and mono values by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (c930bfc)
- fix(cli): send an absolute path from cliamp queue by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (96a095b)
- fix(lyrics): treat a NetEase reply with no song list as not found by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (9321e91)
- docs(claude): state that tests read the docs and the example config by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (4de3ae7)
- docs(claude): isolate HOME only for the cliamp binary by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (b5c552e)
- docs(claude): list the platform file suffixes that the tree uses by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (81b8cbf)
- docs(keys): name SoundCloud and Yandex Music as Ctrl+F providers by Bjarne Oeverli (@bjarneo) (12b7e2a)
